historical_record.description: The park police stables were built in 1936.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Barnes-Lim the contract to rehabilitate the Park Police Station and the Park Police Stables in Golden Gate Park.

With a new lease to Golden Gate Park Stables, Inc., the Recreation and Park Commission approved its building plan for the stables: a new office and residence of about 1,000 square feet, a new arena at the east end of Little Speedway Meadow, a new day barn, and rebuilt stalls and arenas.
